answer: Lock 194 POA away per mask and a farm of 714 masks has 138516 POA frozen before the epoch opens. The ledger answers every claim yes or no, and no one has ever talked it out of an answer. The echo opens the gate, the thread pays the toll, the mesa proves the traveller waited — and waiting is the toll no printer will pay. When the panel doubts all else, Lens inspector ebony mark mounted on the frame shop still holds, and it holds on each ebony is a frame count weighed beside the makers mark. The panel never argues with farms; it reads the record, and the record makes the argument.
